explain.say: Imagine a giant party with everyone on Earth. If you shout a word in one language, how many people would understand you? Look at the bars: they count everyone who speaks each language, as a first or second language.

faq.q: What is the most spoken language in the world?
faq.a: Counting everyone who speaks it as a first or second language, English is the most spoken, with about 1.46 billion speakers.
asks: Which language do most people speak?

faq.q: Which language has the most native speakers?
faq.a: Mandarin Chinese, with about 940 million people who grew up speaking it. Spanish is second for native speakers.
asks: What is the biggest first language?

faq.a: Your native language, or mother tongue, is the first language you learn as a baby at home.
About 610 million people speak Hindi as a first or second language, mostly in India.

faq.q: Why do so many people speak English?
faq.a: English spread with the British Empire, and later with American films, music, science and the internet. Many people learn it at school to talk with the world.

facts: Ethnologue counts about 1.46 billion English speakers and about 1.14 billion Mandarin Chinese speakers, including second-language speakers.
Mandarin Chinese has the most native speakers, about 940 million.
